games.title: VoidRush
games.subtitle: Swallow the whole map
games.description: Steer your hole and devour everything that fits — cars, houses, skyscrapers. Grow bigger than rival holes before the timer hits zero.

games.title: Crowd Clash Runner
games.subtitle: Grow your crowd, smash the gates
games.description: Steer your crowd through power gates, dodge hazards, grab crates, and race for the finish. Casual endless-runner energy with shop upgrades.

games.title: Drop & Fuse
games.subtitle: Match orbs. Chain merges. Don’t overflow.
games.description: Drop glowing orbs into the bin. Same sizes fuse into the next tier — chain big merges for high scores, but never cross the danger line.
